title: project.json v0 - the project card (name, brand, exterior, leads, disclaimer). Card 24 adds the optional analytics block; every other field stays open (additionalProperties) so nothing existing is reshaped.

whatsapp_number.description: international digits, no + and no leading 0 (972XXXXXXXXX); js/lead.js keeps the digits only

webhook_url.description: the Apps Script /exec URL (apps-script/README-he.md); empty = the lead stays on the device; js/lead.js accepts only https:// or a local http test URL

analytics.description: card 24 (D2). Absent or empty posthog_key = no third-party request at all (events stay in the first-party JSONL sink).

posthog_key.description: PostHog PROJECT key (public, phc_...). Never a personal key (phx_...).

whatsapp_viewed_line.description: add 'viewed:<units>' to the buyer's WhatsApp text. Product decision for Eliran (T2); default false = the message is unchanged

lead_secret.description: shared value sent as k with each form lead; the Apps Script refuses leads without it when LEAD_SECRET is set in its Script Properties. It sits in the page, so it filters bots and stray posts, not a determined attacker
